text:
Type: cable-knit throw blanket
Use: warmth and texture on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: chunky knitted yarn, cable and seed stitch panels
Colors: off-white, cream
Shape: rectangular knitted blanket with raised cable braids and textured bands, softly scalloped edges, soft and heavy drape
Feel: cozy, warm, soft, homey
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, light wood, wool and sheepskin; Scandinavian, farmhouse or cabin-style living rooms and bedrooms
